about: Single place to tune the Prototype 1 habitability model (owner: Agent 5). Every numeric value carries a `source` and a `status` ("cited" or "needs human verification"). These are MODEL thresholds, not biological facts: passing them does not mean a planet has life.

rules.checks: Five independent checks (DESIGN.md §18). Critical: temperature, liquidWater. Supporting: pressure, irradiation, tidal. Each check is pass (true), fail (false), or cannot-evaluate (null).
rules.highlyHabitable: Every evaluable check passes AND no critical check is null (supporting checks may be null).
rules.uninhabitable: Any of: (a) the water phase is 'no-liquid-below-triple-point'; (b) liquidWater fails AND surface temperature is outside the EXTENDED temperature range; (c) BOTH critical checks (temperature, liquidWater) fail AND irradiation fails — strongly inconsistent with the habitable ranges on several independent axes (e.g. Venus-like insolation where the one-layer model puts the surface just below freezing).
rules.confidence: Start 'high'. Drop to 'medium' if the atmosphere is user-assumed, any supporting check is null, or the star's Teff was clamped into the Kopparapu validity range. Drop to 'low' if any critical check is null or a mass/radius/eccentricity/orbit-type catalog field is missing (see confidence.lowConfidenceMissingFieldPatterns). 'low' wins over 'medium'.

preferred.note: 0–50 °C. Lower bound = freezing point of pure water at 1 atm. Upper bound ≈ commonly quoted thermal limit for complex (eukaryotic) surface life; animals and plants rarely grow above ~50 °C.
preferred.source: Lower: freezing point of water at 1 atm (IAPWS). Upper: approximate complex-life thermal ceiling (e.g. Tansey & Brock 1972, PNAS 69, 2426 put eukaryotes at ≲60 °C; 50 °C chosen as a conservative model value).

extended.note: −20 °C to 100 °C. Used only to decide how badly the temperature check fails (and for the Uninhabitable rule). Lower bound ≈ the lowest temperature at which known cells still grow and divide. Upper bound = boiling point of water at 1 atm (model choice; some microbes grow even hotter, see knownLifeUpperLimit).
extended.source: Lower: Clarke et al. 2013, PLoS ONE 8, e66207 ('A low temperature limit for life on Earth', ~−20 °C). Upper: boiling point of water at 1 atm (IAPWS).

knownLifeUpperLimit.note: 122 °C — highest temperature at which any organism has been shown to multiply (only at high pressure). Shown in reason text for context; not a pass/fail boundary.
knownLifeUpperLimit.source: Takai et al. 2008, PNAS 105, 10949 (Methanopyrus kandleri strain 116 proliferated at 122 °C under 20–40 MPa).

liquidWater.note: Pass iff the water-phase model (src/physics/water.ts) returns 'liquid'. No numeric threshold here; phase boundaries live in water.ts.

preferred.note: Model choice. 0.1 bar is ~16× water's triple-point pressure (0.00611657 bar), so a usable liquid range exists (water boils near ~46 °C at 0.1 bar). 10 bar is a model ceiling: much thicker atmospheres tend to trap heat strongly and are less Earth-like (Venus ≈ 92 bar). Life itself tolerates far higher pressures in Earth's deep ocean (>1000 bar), so this is not a biological limit.
preferred.source: Model choice by Agent 5; lower bound constrained by the water triple point (IAPWS, 611.657 Pa).

irradiation.note: Star-aware habitable-zone limits in units of Earth's insolation: S_eff = S_eff⊙ + a·T + b·T² + c·T³ + d·T⁴, T = Teff − 5780 K. Pass range = [Early Mars, Recent Venus] (optimistic HZ). Conservative range [Maximum Greenhouse, Runaway Greenhouse 1 M⊕] is reported in the reason text.

teffOffset.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29, eq. 4 (T⋆ = Teff − 5780 K).

teffValidRange.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29 (fits valid for 2600 K ≤ Teff ≤ 7200 K).

recentVenus.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29, Table 1 (arXiv:1404.5292), 'Recent Venus'. Verified against the arXiv table.

runawayGreenhouse1Me.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29, Table 1 (arXiv:1404.5292), 'Runaway Greenhouse (1 M⊕)'. Verified against the arXiv table.

maximumGreenhouse.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29, Table 1 (arXiv:1404.5292), 'Maximum Greenhouse'. Verified against the arXiv table.

earlyMars.source: Kopparapu et al. 2014, ApJL 787, L29, Table 1 (arXiv:1404.5292), 'Early Mars'. Verified against the arXiv table.

extremeStellarTideRelEarth.note: Above this, stellar tidal stress is flagged as extreme (strong tidal heating / volcanism risk). Model choice.
extremeStellarTideRelEarth.source: Model choice by Agent 5; no single literature threshold.

confidence.note: A catalog field in inputs.missing whose lower-cased name contains any of these substrings lowers confidence to 'low' (mass, radius, eccentricity, semi-major axis). Other missing fields (e.g. st_age, st_spectype) do not.
